Detail: Every copper net has exactly one declared class and route.
VIN, SW, VOUT and GND meet the example's declared trace-width floor.
All declared switcher layout review items are marked passed.
Input bypass pads are placed near regulator input and return.
Schottky cathode is near SW and anode is near the power return.
SW reaches the catch diode and inductor; the inductor alone feeds VOUT.
LM2596 fixed-output feedback senses VOUT and remains distinct from SW.
Switch-node route is kept to a compact three-point path.

Educational single-layer PCB review only; the bounded DRC and routing checklist do not establish output regulation, ripple, efficiency, thermal performance, EMC, current capability, or manufacturing approval.
